title: Handled ledger record
description: One record of the handled ledger as read by tools/lib/handled-ledger.mjs. A JS number is an IEEE-754 double, so every field that can exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (2^53-1 = 9007199254740991) is a decimal STRING and every integer field carries a maximum at or below 2^53-1; parseLossless in the consumer keeps the wide tokens JSON.parse would round. A record is either the wide id/timestamp_ns/byte_count/seq row or the legacy entries envelope (or both).

id.description: uint64 work-unit / event id as a decimal string (up to 18446744073709551615); never a JSON number.

timestamp_ns.description: Unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string; above 2^53 since 2001, so a JSON number would already be rounded.

byte_count.description: Payload size in bytes as a decimal string; may exceed 2^53-1.

seq.description: Per-run sequence number; the one integer field, bounded so a JS consumer holds it exactly.

entries.description: Legacy envelope: handled entries carried with the record.
